name: azure-ad
label: Azure Active Directory
description: Manage users, groups, and licenses in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) via Microsoft Graph.

create_group.label: Create Group
create_group.description: Creates a new group in Azure Active Directory.

displayName.label: Display Name
displayName.description: The display name of the group.

mailNickname.label: Mail Nickname
mailNickname.description: Mail alias (e.g. "team-alpha"). Used for mail-enabled groups; must be unique.

mailEnabled.label: Mail Enabled
mailEnabled.description: Set to true for a mail-enabled security or Microsoft 365 group.

securityEnabled.label: Security Enabled
securityEnabled.description: Set to true for a security group.

create_user.label: Create User
create_user.description: Creates a new user in Microsoft Entra ID.

displayName.label: Display Name
displayName.description: The name displayed in the address book for the user.

mailNickname.label: Mail Nickname
mailNickname.description: The mail alias for the user (local part, no @domain).

password.label: Password
password.description: Initial password for the user. Must satisfy your tenant password policy.

forceChangePasswordNextSignIn.label: Force Password Change on Next Sign-in
forceChangePasswordNextSignIn.description: If enabled, the user must change their password at first sign-in.

accountEnabled.label: Account Enabled
accountEnabled.description: Whether the user can sign in.

usageLocation.label: Usage Location
usageLocation.description: Two-letter ISO 3166 country code (e.g. "US"). Required before assigning licenses.

get_group_by_id.label: Get Group by ID
get_group_by_id.description: Retrieves an Azure AD group by its object ID.

groupId.label: Group
groupId.description: Select the group. Groups are loaded from your Microsoft Entra ID directory.

get_group_custom_attributes.label: Get Group Custom Attributes
get_group_custom_attributes.description: Gets extension and custom attributes for an Azure AD group. Returns schema extensions and open extensions.

groupId.label: Group
groupId.description: Select the group. Groups are loaded from your Microsoft Entra ID directory.

get_user_by_id.label: Get User by ID
get_user_by_id.description: Retrieves an Azure AD user by object ID or user principal name.

userId.label: User
userId.description: Select the user. Users are loaded from your Microsoft Entra ID directory.
